meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为系统化的循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂任务拆解为可执行的步骤

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用“超工作模式”将复杂任务分解为系统化的、有证据约束的步骤，并持续跟踪进度，直到目标完成。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动质量检查或带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop，帮我分解这个项目。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流文件并开始执行。
Claude 会查看进度并报告。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 规划并执行这个长期任务。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤分解并执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses 'ultrawork mode' to decompose complex tasks into systematic, evidence-bound steps and tracks progress until the goal is complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and decompose this project for me.
say_en.note: Claude will read the workflow file and begin execution.
Claude will review progress and report.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to plan and execute this long-running task.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose and execute step by step.
